create.name: Dr. Ibrahim Jaffe
create.bio:
Dr. R. Ibrahim Jaffe, a physician, teaches in the Shadhiliyya Sufi tradition. After taking his medical degree at the University of Illinois he practised in Arizona, Hawaii and California, before turning his work fully to spiritual teaching. In 1996 Sidi Muhammad al-Jamal ar-Rifa'i, a Sufi master, accepted him as a student, and after years of training gave him authorisation (ijaza) to teach, with the title Murshid Murabbi Ruhi, a guide and caretaker of the soul.

In 2000 he founded the Jaffe Institute, which later became the Institute of Spiritual Healing and the University of Sufism, where he is founding Chancellor; through the Ma'rifa Foundation he co-leads the Shadhiliyya Ma'rifa community. He teaches Sufism as a path of divine love, centred on dhikr (remembrance of God), purification of the heart, the Divine Names and the heart's stations, along with APIIR-TB, a method of spiritual inquiry he developed. Online he offers Wisdom Wednesdays, a free weekly teaching series, as well as Friday Jumu'ah teachings and a monthly full moon dhikr. His book is God's Way: Sufi Spiritual Healing, and he is based in the Florida Keys.

courses.title: Advanced Sufi Walking
courses.description: An advanced programme created by Dr. Jaffe for students already on the Sufi path, focused on walking the stations of the heart towards fana and unity. It combines in-person or online sessions with monthly Zoom teleclasses and partner practice.

free_resources.title: Wisdom Wednesdays
free_resources.description: A free weekly one-hour online lecture series in which Dr. Jaffe teaches Sufi wisdom on love, the heart and divine guidance. Many past sessions are also posted on the Institute of Spiritual Healing's YouTube channel.

free_resources.title: Friday Jumu'ah with Shaykh Ibrahim Jaffe
free_resources.description: A weekly online Friday gathering of the Shadhiliyya Ma'rifa community with a khutbah (sermon) and teachings led by Dr. Jaffe, open to seekers of any background.

free_resources.title: Full Moon Sufi Dhikr
free_resources.description: A free monthly online dhikr (meditative prayer of remembrance) on the night of each full moon, led by Dr. Jaffe and other teachers, with recordings sent to those on the dhikr list.

flags: Physician: strict health-claim rule applied. His own sites present his work mainly as spiritual healing of serious disease (cancer, heart disease, Lyme, depression and more) and he describes healing his own heart failure; only the Sufi teaching side is included, and a human should decide whether a listing is appropriate at all.

The landing pages kept (Wisdom Wednesdays, Full Moon Dhikr, Advanced Sufi Walking) carry his standard bio or testimonials naming diseases or anxiety, even though the items themselves are Sufi teaching.
Name shown as 'Dr. Ibrahim Jaffe' as on his own site; Shift lists him as 'Dr. R. Ibrahim Jaffe, MD' (legal name Robert Jaffe).
Videos are from the Institute of Spiritual Healing (his organisation) and Sufi Center Minnesota channels, not a personal channel; youtube_url left null.
Possible future Organisation/School listings: University of Sufism / Institute of Spiritual Healing and the Ma'rifa Foundation, which he founded and leads.
Some kept video titles carry dates (e.g. 'Feb 18 2026'); the teachings themselves are evergreen.
Teaches_at rests on the Shift course Radical Healing Through Divine Truth (from 3 Nov 2026), which is itself left out.
left_out: Radical Healing Through Divine Truth (Shift Network live course from 3 Nov 2026): 'radical healing' framing by a physician; course page could not be read (JavaScript only), so dropped as borderline.
God's Way: Sufi Spiritual Healing (book, ASIN B0933Q1BVB): blurb promises relief from illness and healing of many illnesses.
Nurturing Love (linked on his books page): authored by Salima Sanford, not him.
Foundations of Spiritual Healing & Sufism and Year 1: Spiritual Healing & Sufism: pages promise to heal serious illness, cancer, heart disease, depression and more.
Sufi Circle membership ($37): promises to heal physical and mental traumas.

Advanced Spiritual Peacemaking: started April 2026 (dated) and mentions trauma; Muqaddim Ambassador and Sufi Spiritual Ministry programmes: University of Sufism programmes that do not name him as teacher.
Private sessions: one-to-one and framed around physical and emotional healing.

YouTube: 'Sufism and Depression', 'Walking Through Trauma', 'How to Stop Feeling Anxious…', 'Overcoming Loneliness…Healing', 'Is Sufi Healing Only for Sufis? …Divine Healing', 'The Secrets of Miraculous Healing' and other healing-framed interviews; Shift Network channel livestream (belongs to the hub).
